svg.title: More memory can retain less useful evidence
svg.desc: Measured eligible resumptions at sampled UTF-8 context budgets. Note lengths and whole-record packing create the raw-tail dip; this is not model performance.
svg.text: More memory can retain less useful evidence
In-process sensitivity sweep · actual renderer, reader and gate · authored histories
UTF-8 bytes of the context object (transport wrapper excluded)
At 640 bytes, raw tail resumes 9/12; this is a fixture-dependent result.
Dots are measured samples, not a continuous curve. Packing can change sharply between samples.
Original matrix: no unsafe proposals by construction. Separate long-terminal controls expose stale proposals.
